# check-planes: `PlanesOutput`

The `data` payload of `openreadout check FILE --planes --json`, inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `check --planes`.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/check-planes.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/check-planes.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema check-planes`.

## Fields

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | The input file. |
| `format` | `string` | yes | Format id of the input file. |
| `planes` | array of [`PlaneHash`](#planehash) | yes | One row per plane, in the order read. |
| `acquisition` | [`Acquisition`](#acquisition) or `null` |  | Present when the file is not finished; while it is `in_progress` only complete planes are read. See `book/src/guides/lab-shares.md`. |

## Types

### PlaneHash

One row of `check --planes`.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Image index. |
| `level` | `integer` (uint32) |  | Pyramid level (0 = full resolution); omitted when 0. |
| `region` | [`Region`](#region) or `null` |  | The rectangle read (level pixel coordinates) when `--region` was given; the hash and `width`/`height` are then those of the region. Absent = the whole plane. |
| `c` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Channel index. |
| `z` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Z index (focal plane). |
| `t` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Time index. |
| `width` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Plane width in pixels. |
| `height` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Plane height in pixels. |
| `pixel_type` | [`PixelType`](#pixeltype) | yes | Sample type. |
| `samples_per_pixel` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | 1 for grayscale, 3 for interleaved RGB. |
| `xxh3` | `string` | yes | xxh3-128 of the raw little-endian sample bytes, 32 hex chars. |

### Region

A rectangle of a plane, in the pixel coordinates of the resolution level it is read at.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Left edge (column of the first pixel). |
| `y` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Top edge (row of the first pixel). |
| `width` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Width in pixels (at least 1). |
| `height` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Height in pixels (at least 1). |

### PixelType

Sample type of one channel value. Names follow OME-XML `PixelType` values.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"int8"` | Signed 8-bit integer. |
| `"int16"` | Signed 16-bit integer. |
| `"int32"` | Signed 32-bit integer. |
| `"uint8"` | Unsigned 8-bit integer. |
| `"uint16"` | Unsigned 16-bit integer (the usual microscope camera output). |
| `"uint32"` | Unsigned 32-bit integer. |
| `"float"` | 32-bit IEEE 754 floating point. |
| `"double"` | 64-bit IEEE 754 floating point. |
| `"int64"` | Signed 64-bit integer. |
| `"uint64"` | Unsigned 64-bit integer. |
| `"complex"` | Complex number of two 32-bit floats (real, then imaginary): OME `complex`. |
| `"double-complex"` | Complex number of two 64-bit floats (real, then imaginary): OME `double-complex`. |

### Acquisition

`acquisition` in `info`, `info --view structure`, `check` and `check --planes`: present only for
files that are not finished. See `book/src/guides/lab-shares.md`.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | [`AcquisitionState`](#acquisitionstate) | yes | `in_progress` or `interrupted`. |
| `complete_planes` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Planes whose data is entirely on disk. |
| `expected_planes` | `integer` (uint64) or `null` |  | Planes the finished file will hold, when the metadata written so far says so. |
| `modified_ago_s` | `number` (double) | yes | Seconds since the file (or the newest member of a directory store) was modified. |
| `window_s` | `number` (double) | yes | The live window used for the decision, in seconds. |
| `missing` | array of `string` | yes | Structures written at the end of an acquisition that are absent. |
| `tail_bytes` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Bytes after the last complete unit (a unit still being written). |
| `evidence` | array of `string` | yes | The observations behind the decision. |

### AcquisitionState

Whether an incomplete file is still being written.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"in_progress"` | Recently modified and missing only what is written last: still acquiring. |
| `"interrupted"` | Missing what is written last, but unchanged for longer than the live window: the acquisition (or a copy) stopped before the end. |
